_note: Six skincare channels published by .github/workflows/skincare-upload.yml. Each key names its GitHub secrets: YT_SK_REFRESH_<KEY> (refresh token) and YT_SK_CHANNEL_<KEY> (channel ID), both written by skincare-daily/yt_auth.py. YT_SK_CLIENT_ID / YT_SK_CLIENT_SECRET (the Google app) are shared.
